name: One x Shota
source:
I'm different from most girls.
I'm graceful, I'm pleasant to people, I have good style.
That's how people talk of me, but it's not me.
Inside I rage with a sexual desire for only young boys.
This season is the best ever.
Summer vacation. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096641.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我和大多数女孩子都不一样。
举止优雅、待人亲切、身材高挑出众——
旁人总是这样夸赞我，可那并非真正的我。
在我的内心深处，唯有面对年幼的小男孩时，才会燃起滔天的情欲之火。
一年当中最棒的季节终于到了——
那就是暑假。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096641.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
